datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ac.id AS id, ac.kli_id AS custid, ac.acc_no AS accno,
         ac.NAME AS clientname, ac.val_acc
    FROM account ac
    WHERE val_acc = 0 and close_dat is null and ac.filial=:filial
     AND (ac.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'SReserveAccs'))
         )
ORDER BY accno,kli_id

datasets.name: OracleDataSet4
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,tesid, (select name from filial where id= fil_id) fil, 
(select acc_no from account  where id= int_res_accid) hes,(select acc_no from account  where id= fxercacc_id) xerhes
  FROM cm_reserve_turan_filial where tesid=:tesid

datasets.name: IEAccountList
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   id,Acc_No,Val_Acc,Name,FILIAL
  FROM ACCOUNT
 WHERE (bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM smart.cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM smart.cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'IncExpAccounts')))
and (Close_Dat is Null) and FILIAL in (select id from sb_filial)
and FILIAL in(select id from filial)
